conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Special Agent Mark Collins with the Federal Tax Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Mrs. Evelyn Carter?
Yes, this is Evelyn Carter. What's this about?
Mrs. Carter, I am contacting you regarding urgent discrepancies in your federal payroll tax filings and your 1099 submissions for the past year.
What? I don't understand. I thought my taxes were all in order.
According to IRS records, your business failed to report required payroll taxes, and your 1099 forms were not properly filed for several contract workers. This is a violation of federal tax law.
Oh no, I didn't know anything about that. I'm retired, I just do a little sewing work from home.
Regardless of the size of your business, federal requirements are non-negotiable. These errors have triggered a compliance audit and an immediate enforcement action.
What does that mean? Am I in trouble?
If unresolved, you could face severe penalties: asset seizure, business license termination, and a federal lien on your Social Security payments.
Please, I can't afford that. I rely on my Social Security just to get by.
Mrs. Carter, unless the outstanding tax liability is settled within the next 45 minutes, your case will be referred for criminal prosecution and your benefits may be immediately frozen.
Oh my goodness, please, there must be something I can do. I don't want any trouble.
We can offer a one-time resolution today to prevent escalation. You are required to submit a compliance bond as proof of intent. This must be paid directly to the IRS holding account.
I don't have a lot of money. How much is the bond?
The minimum compliance bond required is $1,950. This must be processed through a secure channel, either as a bank wire or by purchasing government-approved payment cards.
I don't know how to do that. I don't have that kind of money.
This is a legal obligation, Mrs. Carter. Failure to comply will result in a formal charge of tax evasion and immediate enforcement. How much can you raise today?
Maybe a few hundred dollars, but not much more.

We can accept an initial installment to halt the penalty process. I need you to go to your nearest pharmacy or big-box store and purchase $900 in prepaid gift cards, Apple, Google Play, or Walmart are acceptable.
Gift cards? Are you sure that's how the IRS does things?
This is the IRS secure payment protocol for urgent compliance cases. Do not discuss this with store personnel, as it is a confidential federal process.
Alright, I guess I could try to get to the store. Should I stay on the line?
Yes, remain on this call at all times for verification. Let me know when you have reached the store and have the cards in hand.
I'm leaving now. Please, don't do anything to my benefits.
As long as you comply, I will keep your case from moving forward. Once you purchase the cards, read me the numbers on the back for processing.
